reason: It adds a new optional `--add-proxy-agent-extension` parameter to the existing `az vm/vmss create/update` commands, extending the existing proxy-agent feature rather than creating a new capability or fixing a bug.
The generator tool intermittently fails because it calls the GitHub API without auth and hits throttling, so the PR fixes that incorrect behavior.
Messages cached from excess link credits are lost when a ReceiveAndDelete receiver is closed, which is incorrect existing behavior that the PR fixes.
The PR adds new `environment` and `generate` commands to the generator tool, which are capabilities that did not exist before.
arm.ParseResourceType returns the wrong resource type for nested deletedAccounts IDs, and the PR fixes that incorrect parsing.
The PR adds a new credential type, AzurePowerShellCredential, to azidentity, a capability that did not exist before.
The PR adds a new check in the release pipeline that verifies the package's development status classifier matches its version (GA or beta). No such check existed before.
Az.Accounts 14.0.0 changed Get-AzAccessToken's output type, breaking the existing AzurePowerShellCredential script, so the update fixes incorrect behavior with the new module.
The PR restores SSO with VS Code by making VisualStudioCodeCredential broker-based, adding a capability that was lost when the credential was deprecated.
Read timeouts were wrongly surfaced as ServiceResponseError, and the PR fixes the requests and aiohttp transports to raise the correct timeout error.
It speeds up existing source checks (MultipleFailingCheck, LongUntranslatedCheck) by batching them into single SQL queries, with no new capability and no bug being fixed.
It adds a new standalone permission, `unit.bulk_edit`, which didn't exist before. Bulk edit currently relies on the unrelated `translation.auto` permission.
Rescanning wrongly wipes unapproved translations when the commit policy only includes approved translations, which is incorrect existing behaviour that the PR fixes.
Drill to Detail by axis value wrongly returns all rows when the axis column has a dataset-level label, and the PR fixes this by mapping axis label filters back to the original column names.
The upload already works but gives generic errors, and the change makes the CSV upload error messages more specific and actionable.
The PR adds a new combined metrics package to avalanchego (uplifted from the EVM repositories), a capability that did not previously exist there.
The PR moves an existing predicate package from the EVM repos into avalanchego, relocating code without intending to change its behaviour.
BlockDB already stores block data, and this change adds compression to improve its disk usage without introducing a new capability.
It adds a new capability that didn't exist: TxClient can be given additional core endpoints through a new option and submits transactions to up to three connections in parallel.
`atmos list vars` and `atmos list values` wrongly report that nested components such as `eks/cluster` don't exist, so the PR fixes broken existing behaviour.
The pruning height calculation is wrong when snapshot-interval changes (it can prune a height mid-snapshot or get stuck), and the PR fixes that incorrect behaviour.
The PR adds a capability that didn't exist: forcing verbose (info-level) logging during upgrades, so operators with error-level logging can see upgrade progress.
The PR adds a new integration that hooks sys.unraisablehook to report unraisable exceptions to Sentry, a capability that did not previously exist.
The SDK was evaluating complex Django objects (likely lazy querysets) when recording span data, causing severe performance regressions, and the PR fixes this incorrect behaviour.
The PR adds a new opt-in capability, recording code source location (code.filepath, code.function, etc.) on slow outgoing HTTP request spans, which did not exist before.
The genbot build failed because PR descriptions exceeded GitHub's 65536-character limit, and the PR fixes the description generation to avoid that failure.
The PR adds .repo-metadata.json generation to librariangen, a capability that didn't exist, so Librarian-migrated modules get their metadata files again (per the issue).
The PR adds statistics generation for the head block, a new capability for per-block index planning statistics that did not exist before.
Terragrunt wrongly ignores `.tofu` files (e.g. skipping units with only `.tofu` files), so the PR fixes this to give `.tofu` the same treatment as `.tf`.
A regression in 0.91 made discovery fail with an unrecoverable parse error on a config that worked in 0.90, and the PR fixes how discovery handles those parsing errors.
The PR adds retries and error logging for failed CoolMaster communication, improving resilience and diagnostics of existing behaviour, rather than fixing a clearly wrong code path.
Setup failed for child accounts because the group fetch was blocked by parental controls, so the fix ignores that error and lets the integration load.
The PR adds support for a migrated Hue bridge (the new Hue Pro bridge), a capability the integration didn't have before.
Devices removed from the Amazon account stayed in Home Assistant with no way to delete them, so the PR adds stale-device removal to fix that.
The PR adds a scene platform to the integration, a new capability, so scenes are exposed as scene entities instead of lights, which fixes the issue's missing scenes.
The migration flow fails when the old adapter is unplugged, and the PR adds retry steps so the flow can finish in that case. This fixes wrong existing behaviour.
Supervisor's aiohttp session kept using the DNS config read at startup, so later /etc/resolv.conf changes were ignored; recreating the session after the DNS plug-in loads fixes this wrong behaviour.
The issue reports that Supervisor fails to recover when DNS is unavailable at boot, and the PR fixes this by making the DNS plug-in restart more robust.
Selecting `my_stream.prop.*` failed to select the parent property, causing schema pruning to drop it, so the PR fixes this incorrect selection behaviour.
Changing a plugin's Python version currently fails because the old venv with the incompatible interpreter is reused, so the PR fixes this by recreating the venv.
Slice indexing on a graph raised a TypeError because it was never supported, and the PR adds that capability instead of correcting wrong existing behaviour.

SkipLayerNormFusion wrongly failed to fuse LayerNormalization/SimplifiedLayerNormalization when epsilon or stash_type were left at their ONNX defaults, so the fix corrects incorrect existing matching behaviour.
Range columns partition pruning mishandled the NullEQ <=> operator, producing an empty result or a "too many partitions matching for PointGetPlan" error, and the PR fixes that.
ANALYZE panicked with an index-out-of-range error when generated columns depended on columns skipped by tidb_analyze_skip_column_types, and the PR fixes this by filtering out those generated columns.
The issue is labeled an enhancement: pseudo stats already work but use too much memory in the stats cache, and the PR reduces that footprint without adding a capability or fixing incorrect results.

The issue is labeled an enhancement: column predicate usage updates already work, but the PR reduces how often the column_stats_usage table is written so there are fewer write conflicts and updates run faster in large clusters.
The PR adds a new st.pdf element, a PDF viewer capability that didn't exist in Streamlit before.
The PR adds a new `border` parameter to `st.table`, a capability that didn't exist, so users can render borderless tables.
The PR adds a new capability, triggering a rerun when a dialog is dismissed, which did not exist before.
The PR adds a new `default` parameter to `st.tabs` so an app can open on a chosen tab, which wasn't possible before.
The PR adds hard-mode HyperNode-based binpack scheduling to network topology awareness, a capability that did not exist before.
The PodGroup isn't updated after its StatefulSet's pod template changes, which leaves it stuck Pending. The PR fixes that.
The PR adds a new opt-in option that disables the default config fallback and aborts startup on invalid configs, which the scheduler did not support before.
The PR adds a new mechanism (a remaining-amount value in outbound CCTX data) to refund unused tokens to the sender in connected chain calls, which previously went back to custody.

The PR fixes wrong behavior where retried inbound votes redundantly broadcast failing 500k-gas transactions, congesting the mempool, and adds guards to stop broadcasting when the mempool is congested or the base fee is too high.
The PR adds an expiration date filter to the ListSessions API so expired sessions can be excluded, which extends an existing API with a new option instead of fixing a clear defect.
